name: BRL-52537
summary: BRL-52537 is a drug which acts as a potent and highly selective κ-opioid agonist. It has neuroprotective effects in animal studies, and is used for research into potential treatments for stroke and heart attack as well as more general brain research.

pharmacology.text: BRL-52537 is a drug which acts as a potent and highly selective κ-opioid agonist.

uses.text: It has neuroprotective effects in animal studies, and is used for research into potential treatments for stroke and heart attack as well as more general brain research.

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Kappa opioid agonists characteristically cause feeling detached, dysphoria, confusion and sometimes hallucinations, along with sedation.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。kappa 鴉片促效劑典型地造成脫離感、情緒惡劣、混亂，有時還有幻覺，並伴隨鎮靜。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。kappa 鸦片促效剂典型地造成脱离感、情绪恶劣、混乱，有时还有幻觉，并伴随镇静。

fact.en: It is a research tool that activates only the kappa opioid receptor. In animals it protects nerve cells after a stroke, which is why it is studied in brain and heart injury rather than for pain.
fact.zh: 它是只活化 kappa 鴉片受體的研究工具。在動物身上，它能在中風後保護神經細胞，因此被用於腦部與心臟損傷的研究，而非止痛。
fact.zhHans: 它是只活化 kappa 鸦片受体的研究工具。在动物身上，它能在中风后保护神经细胞，因此被用于脑部与心脏损伤的研究，而非止痛。
